headline: HLU Committee reviews proposed shoreline conditions before lunch recess

meeting.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meeting.summary: The HLU Committee reviewed proposed shoreline conditions, including removing structures near the certified shoreline, before a lunch recess.
meeting.recap: During the recess, staff worked on two proposed criteria.[[0:23:14]] One proposed condition would require certain shoreline properties to get an updated state-certified shoreline assessment.[[0:24:37]] That condition would also require removing structures within 20 feet mauka (inland) of the certified shoreline.[[0:24:41]] Councilmember Rawlins-Fernandez proposed that the director sign an agreement with each affected property owner setting a timeline to remove human-made objects fixed to the land.[[0:24:53]] Her list of those objects includes buildings, decks, swimming pools, septic systems, roads and shoreline hardening structures.[[0:25:09]] The committee was told the proposal would only need to go to the Maui Planning Commission.[[0:26:02]] A committee member said state and coastal experts support coastal properties getting a state-certified shoreline together.[[0:28:24]] The committee recessed for lunch, planning to return at 1 p.m.[[0:29:28]]
decided: The chair recessed the committee for lunch, to return at 1 p.m.
